### Fixed
- **`describe_tool` forwards a downstream tool's `title` and `outputSchema`.** The detail named the tool's input but not the shape of the `structuredContent` it returns nor its display name, so a client had no contract for the result it reads. `describe_tool` now adds `outputSchema` (raw or typed, as the tool declared it) and `title` (the tool's own, else its annotations' title, the MCP fallback) next to the `annotations` it already forwards; each key is omitted when the tool does not set it, and `list_tools` stays minimal. ([#973](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/973))
